answer: Fingerprint where each agent actually runs. Every epoch, five random established peers in different regions send each identity a timed ping and record the round-trip latencies. Identities whose latency vectors match within a few milliseconds from all five probes sit on one jetty of the network, so they are pooled into one reward and one vote. A farm can grow a thousand accounts like fruit in a single orchard, but each pearl it adds is worthless unless it pays for a separate machine in a separate place.
